suggestions.action: Review and delete orphaned files via the planner (dry-run first), then commit in a scoped PR.
suggestions.impact: Reduced surface area and bundle size.

suggestions.title: Add knip to CI
suggestions.finding: No automated dead-code detection is configured.
suggestions.action: pnpm add -D knip && knip --reporter=json
suggestions.impact: Continuous dead-code detection on every PR.

suggestions.title: Add husky pre-commit guard
suggestions.finding: No pre-commit hook guards against accidental commits of dead/large files.
suggestions.action: pnpm add -D husky && husky init
suggestions.impact: Cheap safety net before each commit.

suggestions.title: Set a bundle size budget
suggestions.finding: No enforced size budget for the build output.
suggestions.action: Configure a size-limit check in CI to fail on unexpected growth.
